violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: RAW CHICKEN DUMPLING MIX STORED ABOVE RAW PORK AND SHRIMP DUMPLING MIX.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

OBSERVED VARIOUS STAGES OF LIVE ROACHES: ON PAPER TOWEL AND IN PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER; ON DISHWASHER MACHINE, ON WALL BEHIND DISHWASHER MACHINE, ON RICE BAGS IN DRY STORAGE AREA; ON FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE AREA, ON FLOOR ON ENTRY TO KITCHEN, UNDER COUNTER IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE INCREASED LICENSED PEST CONTROL SERVICE.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Dead or trapped COCKROACHES were found on the premises: IN FRONT SERVICE AREA UNDER COUNTERS, FLOORS IN DINING NEAR ENTRANCE OF KITCHEN; ON STACKED CARRY OUT BAGS; ON FLOORS THROUGHOUT KITCHEN; ON CART NEAR WOK LINE; ON FOOD CANS ON SHELVING IN DRY STORAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE THOROUGH CLEANING THROUGH OUT THE FACILITY BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the HOLES/GAPS IN CEILING AROUND UTILITY LINES IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SEAL HOLES/GAPS TO PREVENT ENTRY TO PESTS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: RICE STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK KITCHEN AND ON WOODEN PALETTE IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO STORE FOOD ITEMS 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE SANITIZER BUCKETS WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO STORE WET WIPING CLOTHS ARE PREPARED FOR EACH WORK STATION. CHANGE SOLUTIONS AT LEAST EVERY 4 HOURS. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: KNIFE STORED BETWEEN FLAT TOP AND PREP SINIK IN FRONT SERVICE AREA; NOODLE STRAINER STORED ON SIDE OF HANDWASH SINK.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE THOROUGH CLEANING OF KITCHEN EQUIPMENT BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC PROVIDE THOROUGH CLEANING BEFORE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW MEATS STORE ABOVE PORTIONED PREPARED SAUCES IN 2 DOOR BLACK REFRIGERATOR (DINING).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD RAW GROUND PORK DURING INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food.
